description_html:
<section aria-labelledby="courseDescription">
    This course is a student success skills course for first-year undergraduate students in the college of STEM. This course provides introduction to the various disciplines within STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics). It is designed to orient new students to the University and the ATU College of STEM, familiarize them with the resources and opportunities available, and build foundational skills necessary for success in their studies.
    
</section>
